head: codex/291-initialized-decomposition-recovery
title: [v0.92][C-SDLC] Fix initialized decomposition duplicate-edge recovery (#291)
body:
## Summary

Fixes initialized decomposition recovery graph validation so duplicate directed edges fail closed before recovery mutates issue/card state.

## Changes

- Reject duplicate `(from, to, relation)` graph edges in `validate_decomposition_graph`.
- Add a focused negative regression for duplicate `child-a -> child-b` recovery input.
- Preserve typed #291 lifecycle truth through recovery, canonical fresh review assignment, and PASS review record.

## Validation

- `cargo fmt --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --check`
- `git diff --check`
- `cargo test --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --test initialized_decomposition_recovery` (2 passed)
- `env CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/Volumes/FastWork/adl-builds/291/csdlc-v2 cargo clippy --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`
